messages:
Jordan L: Quick sync — can we confirm owners for the console observability work targeting next sprint? Need clear owners for: dashboard panels (service + frontend views), trace hook rollout (frontend + backend), error-analysis dashboards, and the trace retention gate (>30d). Who's picking what?

Priya N: I'll own the dashboard panels (service-level and error-rate views). Plan: wire up failure_rate, latencies P50/P95, and a top-5 endpoints chart. Aiming for MVP by Tue EOD.

Anna F: I'll take the frontend trace hook rollout for the SPA. Question: do we sample client traces at 10% or proxy full traces to backend? leaning to sample then stitch. Need a small instrumentation PR.

Mike T: Platform will cover backend trace ingestion, retention changes, and the storage migration. Blocker: retention policy change requires a schema migration on trace-store. Can we schedule a maintenance window? Also we need to coordinate topic renames for the kafka consumers.

Sara R: I'll do the error-analysis views + alerting integration. I need the failure_rate counter from Priya and a small example log schema (stack + span_id). Also want a canary synthetic to validate error dashboards after rollout.

Priya N: @Sara R will expose failure_rate as prometheus metric and push a sample dashboard JSON to the repo. PR will be draft by Mon.

Anna F: For trace sampling, here's the snippet I'm planning to land in the SPA:

```js
// sampling config
const TRACE_SAMPLE_RATE = 0.1; // 10% client-side
if (Math.random() < TRACE_SAMPLE_RATE) { startTrace(); }
```

Anna F: Will open PR for instrumentation and a small README on stitching with backend span_id.

Mike T: Maintenance window suggestion: Wed 02:00-04:00 UTC (low traffic). ops-bot please confirm availability.

ops-bot: Maintenance window check: Wed 02:00-04:00 UTC is available. Please file a runbook and rollback steps at least 24h prior.

Mike T: Thanks. PRs I'll need:
- trace-store schema migration (PR: platform/trace-store#412)
- kafka topic rename (platform/ingest#89)
- retention config change (platform/config#37)

Jordan L: Can we get explicit owners in this thread so I can update the roadmap card? Also any cross-team deps?

Priya N: Dashboards -> Priya N (metrics + panels). Dep: platform must expose traces/trace_id linking.

Anna F: Frontend trace hook -> Anna F. Dep: backend stitch endpoint + sample header contract from Mike.

Mike T: Backend trace ingestion & retention -> Mike T. Dep: DB migration, ops window, and small infra PRs above.

Sara R: Error-analysis + alerts -> Sara R. Dep: Priya's metrics and Anna's span_id consistency. I'll add synthetic test plan to the repo.

Jordan L: Great. Action items: everyone add their PR links to the roadmap card, tag expected delivery date. I'll block the Wed window in calendar but won't merge anything until runbook is posted.

Priya N: Quick note — dashboard JSON will live in infra/dashboards/console-observability.

Mike T: I'll draft the runbook tonight: includes migration steps, smoke queries, and rollback. Will link here.

Sara R: If anyone's unavailable during the window, flag now.

Anna F: I'm good for the window.

Priya N: Good for me.

Mike T: Also flagging a risk: if retention migration slips, we may need to drop to 14d temporary retention for cost reasons — will surface if needed.

Jordan L: OK — thanks team. I'll follow up with the roadmap update after PR links are posted. :thumbsup:
